counterevidence: Revenue for private neolabs is reported by The Information and Sacra behind paywalls.
definition: Primary rounds raised by labs founded 2023 or later divided by their annualised revenue (P1 seed indicator 9).
name: Neolab capital raised per dollar of revenue
tracker_interpretation: Unpublished until a revenue series exists for the neolabs.
unpublished_reason: Not measurable from free sources: the neolabs' rounds are filed or reported, but none of them has a revenue figure in Epoch or a filing, so the denominator does not exist.
why_it_matters: Overfunding relative to revenue is the pattern that preceded every prior installation-phase crash.
